Pr econtraint as per manufacturing and supplying standards by wit h it should be Precontraint Technology. The membrane should confirm to the manufacturing standard of being pre stretched in both weft and waft direction during manufacturing to perform b est dynamic stability in both weft and waft direction with approv ed installers and Manufacturer for Architectural Roofing includin g removing the existing tensile fabric on existing tensile structu re. The fabric must be HT polyester yarns 1100 Dtex coated wit h uniform 230 micron PVC coating over the polyester yarn. The top quote over the PVC must be of high concentration with easy clean ability and superior white pigmentation of the membrane. minimum weight should be 900 to 950g/sqm (EN ISO 2286-2), 4 200 / 4000 N/50 mm (EN ISO 1421) and tear strength of 550 / 5 00 N (DIN 53.363) and with a Guarantee of 15 yrs from the man ufacturer, Adhesion 120 N (EN ISO 2411). Flame retardancy Bs2 d0, Quality in conformity with ISO 9001 with 15 years warranty f rom manufacturer. The Membrane fabrication should conform to standards of desired profile as per approved shop drawing inclu ding necessary designing with non-linear design software, seam ing machine at least capacity from 20 kv to 25kv 40 mm. ancho r bolt, nut and washer are to be structure steel cables should be with good class swagged cable end connectors. The existing str 1 ucture should be allied with PU based primer and PU based pai Sqm 275 nt in minimum 3 coats Make Asian/Berger. Structure frames with all fittings and fixtures such as Stainless s teel. End Plate, Shackles, Rigging Screws, Turnbuckles, swedge, fork, keder rods & galvanized MS strands with stainless steel en d terminals as per Drawing / Detail & as per particular/ technical specifications and as per the directions of Engineer-in-charge an d the submitted approved drawing. The contactor shall provide original Warranty certificate issued by his company with manufacturer warranty. Manufacturer’s Guarantee against tear should also be furnished by successful bidder. The structure should be leak proof throughout the warranty peri od.
